title: Navimower 0.4.6-beta8

## Direct Prepared Live render source

This beta removes the remaining Prepared Live dependency on the full Map API payload builder.

0.4.6-beta7 field diagnostics confirmed that full active-session copies are gone, but Prepared Live still called `_map_payload_with_sessions()` to obtain legacy trail segments. That path materializes the legacy active trail separately and can create occasional high `card_materialization` latency on large active sessions.

### One History snapshot, one route split

Prepared Live now:

- captures one minimal active-session render snapshot from History;
- derives legacy all-movement segments directly from that snapshot;
- derives cutting/travel semantic segments from the same `split_session_route_segments()` pass;
- no longer calls `_map_payload_with_sessions()` from the Prepared Live build path;
- no longer asks History to materialize a second legacy trail representation for the same build.

The public Map API and its legacy `trail` / `trail_segments` compatibility fields are unchanged and remain available for older cards and explicit Map API consumers.

### Expected effect

For large active sessions, Prepared Live work should now scale with one route snapshot and one classification/split pass instead of combining a render snapshot with a separate legacy Map payload materialization.

This specifically targets the remaining occasional `card_materialization` spikes observed after 0.4.6-beta7 while retaining the low-cost `render_snapshots` path introduced there.

### Compatibility

- No changes to History retention or restart recovery.
- No changes to fresh-install vendor-trail filtering.
- No changes to mower commands, Schedule, Resume, Gate or zone progress.
- No change to Prepared History archives.
- Public/legacy Map API payload format remains unchanged.
